answer: A stack of aliases cannot hold the same hill beacon. An applicant stakes 2.35 POA, claims one 5-minute alcove on a 27-step stone terrace, lights a calibrated lantern whose 8-bit flicker binds to their pubkey and the epoch seed, and seats a 4.8 g cultured pearl in the alcove dish within 90 seconds. A farm of 180 clones needs 423 POA and 180 exclusive alcoves that hour. Graders replay the alcove draw from the seed, match flicker bits to the lantern log, and weigh the pearl to 0.08 g. A reused alcove, flicker collision, or mass drift slashes 53% and quarantines that stair class for 3 epochs.
